component: Verify-block attention over kv_q8 (affine int8) K/V: one pass per KV head for all GQA heads and verify rows
context_prs: #91 (a85b086, optional BF16 target KV, shared attention kernels)
modifications: Design only; no Splash code copied. Taken: a threadgroup per (KV head, history split) owning the fused M = verify rows x query heads tile, per-row causal limits inside each split, fp32 normalized split partials merged in fixed order.

Rewritten for mlx2's MLX affine kv_q8 format (packed uint32 codes, bf16/fp16 scale and bias per 64 channels, 2/4/8 bits, separate key/value widths) read from strided live cache views; each 16-token tile is dequantized once into threadgroup memory.
QK and PV use 8x8 simdgroup_matrix products under mx.fast.metal_kernel instead of Splash's Metal 4 tensor ops; fused rows above 32 split into fused-row groups.
Adds per-batch-row left padding (BatchQuantizedKVCache) and an identity-checked mask contract: batch caches register the causal masks they build, so the seam never reads a mask array.
Segmented self-MTP quantized rows pass 'causal' for their row slices (also moves B>1 single-row decode onto the existing decode kernel).
Default on above MIN_CONTEXT for 1-8 rows; MLX2_QSDPA_VERIFY_KERNEL=0 restores the previous composed path and explicit row masks exactly.
validation: tests/test_qsdpa_verify_metal.py: CPU reference of the kernel's split ranges, causal limits, left padding, fused groups and merge vs dequantize + SDPA; mask contract; routing; Metal equivalence (MLX2_RUN_GPU_TESTS=1)
qualification/runs/sp-verifyattn-20260925: error sweep, microbenchmarks, 27B server A/B with self-MTP K=2
